INSERT INTO club_invites
                 (club_id, code, created_by, max_uses, created_at, expires_at, invitee_id)
             SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, at, at + $5::int4 * interval '1 day', $6
             FROM clock_timestamp() AS at
             ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING
             RETURNING id
